items.title: 9.3 Digital ishtirak aur computing mein masawat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of digital collaboration and equity in computing (PDF 128-131).

blocks.text: Digital ishtirak ka matlab mukhtalif jagahon se mushtarka kaamon, projects ya khayalat par mil kar kaam karne ke liye technology ka istemal hai (Fig 9.3). Team work, rabta aur zimmedari teams ko apne maqasid kaamyabi se hasil karne deti hain. Computing mein masawat (equity) ka matlab hai ke har shakhs, pas-e-manzar ya salahiyat se qata-e-nazar, hissa le sake aur digital wasail tak barabar rasai rakhe; ishtirak ko insaf ke saath milana shamooliyat wale, kaar-amad parhne aur kaam ke mahol banata hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar muskurate talaba laptops ke saath aik mez par baithe hain; laptops ki pusht dekhne wale ki taraf hai. Upar aik cloud teen lakeeron se group se jura hai. Tasveer par koi label nahi.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.3: Digital ishtirak (collaboration) (kitab ki Figure 9.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Cloud aik mushtarka jagah hai jahan files online rakhi jati hain. Teen lakeerein dikhati hain ke chaaron talaba alag laptops se usi aik cloud se jure hain, is liye sab aik hi dastavez par aik saath kaam kar sakte hain.

Online kaam teams ko aik jagah hue baghair khayalat share karne, raye dene aur kaam mukammal karne deta hai, mushtarka dastavezat, guftagu aur wasail ke zariye. Wazeh rabta aur baahami izzat kaamyabi ki kunji hain, aur online team work talaba ko aise jadeed daftaron ke liye tayyar karta hai jahan door se kaam aam hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Wazeh rabta rakhne wali teams kaam jaldi aur kam ghaltiyon ke saath mukammal karti hain.

Digital team work ko wazeh rabta aur bharosa chahiye: jab har koi hissa dale aur sune to projects hamwaar chalte aur koi be-khabar nahi rehta. Group chats, email aur video calls teams ko jore rakhte hain. Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams aur Zoom jaise foran chalne wale tools kai logon ko aik hi file aik saath edit karne, chat aur meeting karne dete, waqt bachate aur sab ko hum-aahang rakhte hain.
Masawat aur rasai ke liye design

Barabar rasai ka matlab har shakhs ko technology aur Internet use karne ka yaksan mauqa hai, qabil-e-aitbaar devices, connections aur digital maharat ke saath. Kuch log mazoori, zaban ki rukawat ya wasail ki kami ka samna karte hain; inhein samajhna designers ko sab ke liye hal banane deta hai, aur mazoor logon ke liye qabil-e-rasai design products ko sab ke liye asan banata hai. Shamooliyat wali applications kamzor nazar walon ke liye screen readers, videos par subtitles aur kai zabanon ke options, saade layouts aur wazeh text ke saath, rakhti aur mukhtalif users ke saath test hoti hain.

blocks.alt: Chhe dabbe: Screen reader (nazar ki kamzori wale), Subtitles (videos ke saath matn), Kai zabanein (zaban ka intikhab), Saada layout (aasan istemal), Wazeh matn (parhne mein aasan), Users se testing (mukhtalif log aazmayein).
blocks.caption: Shamooliyat wali (inclusive) applications ki khoobiyan (is sabaq ke liye hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Groups mein chhota kaam, jaise poster ki mansooba bandi, karein aur wazeh online tarz ke paighamat ki mashq karein.

items: Kirdar tay karein: har rukn apna kaam jaane, maslan aik tehqeeq, aik maloomat munazzam aur aik aakhri presentation tayyar kare.
Kaam sambhalein: checklists aur timelines team ko sahi raste par aur deri se bachate hain.
Team ke maqasid: mushtarka maqsad simt deta aur taawun barhata hai.
Baad mein ghaur: guftagu karein ke kya achha raha (jaise achha rabta) aur kya behtar ho (jaise chhooti deadlines), taake ghaltiyon se seekh kar behtar team member banein.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Wazeh kirdar, kaam ka intizam aur maqasid ka ta'ayyun team work ki kaar-amadi barhate hain.

blocks.prompt: Aap ke chaar ke group ko online presentation banani hai. Batayein ke kirdaron, kaam ki fehrist aur mushtarka dastavez se kaam kaise munazzam karenge.
blocks.explanation: Har rukn ko kirdar dein (researcher, likhne wala, designer, pesh karne wala); kaam, zimmedar aur deadlines mushtarka checklist mein; slides aik mushtarka file mein jis ki edit rasai sirf team ko; progress dekhne ke liye mukhtasar video meeting; aur aakhir mein mil kar ghaur ke kya behtar ho.

items: Digital ishtirak: mushtarka online kaam; masawat: sab ke liye barabar rasai.
Wazeh rabta; foran chalne wale tools (Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams, Zoom).
Shamooliyat wala design (screen readers, subtitles, zabanein); kirdar, kaam ka intizam, maqasid, ghaur.
